description: Convert one or more cURL commands or HAR (HTTP Archive 1.2) JSON traces into a valid, production-ready Apache JMeter .jmx test plan XML with HTTP Request Defaults, Header Managers, Cookie Managers, timeouts, and assertions. Supports GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and RFC 9838 QUERY methods.

durationSeconds.description: Test duration in seconds (0 = disabled, default: 0).

filterStaticAssets.description: Filter out images/css/fonts when parsing HAR (default: true).

includeAssertions.description: Add HTTP 200/201/204 Response Code assertions (default: true).

input.description: cURL command string (single, multiline, or batch) or HAR 1.2 JSON text (max 1MB).

parameterizeAuth.description: Extract Bearer token into ${AUTH_TOKEN} variable (default: true).

parameterizeHost.description: Extract common host into HTTP Request Defaults and ${BASE_URL} (default: true).

testPlanName.description: Name of the JMeter Test Plan (default: "cURL Converted Plan").

name: convert_curl_or_har_to_jmx
title: Convert cURL or HAR to JMeter JMX Test Plan
